formate.intro: CILS A1 is one exam for one level. As far as we know, the written exam has papers for listening (ascolto), reading (lettura), language structures (analisi delle strutture di comunicazione) and writing (produzione scritta), and there is a separate oral exam (produzione orale). The number of tasks, timings, scoring and the pass rule are to verify on the official page: this site does not state them as fact.
